gizmo.title: Ukusesha amagama
gizmo.description: Igridi yezinhlamvu enamagama afihliwe. Abafundi bathepha uhlamvu lokuqala nolokugcina lwegama ngalinye. Kuzilolongela ukubona ukuthi igama lipelwa kanjani, hhayi ukuthi lisho ukuthini.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Lokho abafundi abacelwa ukuthi bakuthole, okuboniswa esihlokweni.

configure.title: Amagama
configure.description: Amagama okufanele afihlwe. Izikhala nezimpawu zokuloba zishiywa ngaphandle kwegridi. Amagama angangeni aboniswa ohlwini ngenkathi uhlela futhi ashiywa ngaphandle kubafundi.

advanced.title: Usayizi wegridi
advanced.description: Izinhlamvu ohlangothini ngalunye, 4 kuya ku-16. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kulingane negama elide kakhulu (kuze kufike ku-12). Ngaphezu kuka-12 kuskroleka eceleni efonini.

advanced.title: Amagama atshekile
advanced.description: Futhi fihla amagama ngokutsheka. Kunzima kakhulu.

advanced.title: Amagama ahlehlayo
advanced.description: Futhi fihla amagama abhalwe ngokuhlehla. Kunzima kakhulu.

advanced.title: Umbala wokugcizelela
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa we-chip yesihloko, uhlamvu lokuqala olukhethiwe nenkinobho.
